# Oliver Sauer · osauer.dev

Updated: 2026-09-30

This is Oliver Sauer’s personal work in generative AI,
trading and Go systems. Nothing here is investment advice.

- [Desk](https://osauer.dev/desk/): A personal investment workspace for portfolio
  review, market briefings and an AI analyst. A small private preview is arranged
  directly with Oliver on LinkedIn. It is not a commercial service. Screens use
  synthetic simulation data; no investment performance is claimed.
- [Canary CLI](https://osauer.dev/canary/): Desk's open-source broker and risk
  foundation, with a native Go implementation of the Interactive Brokers TWS
  protocol, a command line, read-only MCP tools and a paired app. Standard
  downloads have no order-entry path. Agents cannot authorize broker writes.
- [Torok](https://osauer.dev/torok/): The private Go runtime behind Desk's agent
  workflows, with saved progress, schedules, budgets and recovery.
- [HyperServe](https://osauer.dev/hyperserve/): An open-source Go HTTP server
  library, built around net/http, with optional MCP.
- [Tower](https://osauer.dev/tower/): A private experiment in coordinating coding
  agents. No public download.

Use the Canary handbook and setup guides for operational details. The landing
pages are short introductions. Desk, Torok and Tower remain private; do not
infer a public installer, pricing or commercial availability.
